goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann Konsumentscheidungen bei knappen Mitteln unter Berücksichtigung eigener Anreize, Nachhaltigkeit, Werbung, Verkaufspsychologie und verhaltensökonomischer Einflussfaktoren reflektiert begründen.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: A thoughtful shopper holds a budget purse and compares need, sustainability and cost criteria with a time-limited advertising display. Repaired shoes provide an alternative to new shoes. The shopper questions the display instead of blindly obeying it, without declaring every discount false or every new purchase wrong.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px thinker, purse, repaired versus new shoes, checklist icons and Nur heute question remain visible and distinct.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px repair details, conceptual checklist and advertisement timing clearly support reflective choice.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: Shop signs and offer board publicly face shoppers; no private notebook or display is oriented incorrectly.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: Checklist ticks depict considered criteria, not a verified result or a universal moral verdict. Resource conservation through longer use is illustrated qualitatively, not as an exhaustive life-cycle calculation.
